Things aren't as bad as they were in 2003, when over 1,000 homicides took place in the UK (or the 90s when they were higher still), but with recent unchecked migration Britons have seen a consistent uptick in stabbings and shootings. Incidents of rape have increased by [29%](http://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2016/apr/21/rate-england-wales-2015-rises-11).

However, as the UK [abolished](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_punishment_in_the_United_Kingdom) the death penalty in 1965, it has been expensive to house violent criminals on British soil.

It was announced today that the UK's worst prisoners, those who might have previously been sentenced to death, will be sentenced to a fate at Channeltraz. There are approximately [86,000](http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/shared/spl/hi/uk/06/prisons/html/nn2page1.stm) people in prisons in England, Wales, and Scotland, and at last count, some [27%](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/offender-management-statistics-quarterly--2) of these had committed "violence against the person offences."

Given the murder rate in the UK of about [1%](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_intentional_homicide_rate), of these ~23,000 violent offenders, some 230 have been sentenced to life in prison. Those convicts will be sent to Channeltraz immediately upon its construction. Since the prison platform will have 1,000 beds, there is room for murderers from other countries as well, which will help subsidize the construction costs of the platform.

The remaining space will be split between other UK criminals, such as serial rapists, those convicted of terrorist plots, and other universally reprehensible crimes against human decency.

May God have mercy on their souls, for they have shown none themselves.

There has been some concern among the Labour Party that racial profiling might play into the Channeltraz allocation, however the conservative majority claims that racial statistics for violent crime, which confidently point the finger at [migrant groups](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Race_and_crime_in_the_United_Kingdom), will have nothing to do with Channeltraz. Those allocations will be based solely on the severity of the crime and the length of the sentence, especially those serving life terms. Nonetheless, some estimates say that the Channeltraz population will be at least 3/4 Caribbean/African descent.

In related news, the UK is also working on its plan to relocate illegal immigrants back to their home countries, or in the event of no-return holds (such as a civil war or other inhumane return environment), to a holding camp in a nearby country.
